info.title: HacKU Stop 1 local application
info.description: Local-only implementation. Authentication and resource authorization occur before idempotency lookup, then CAS. Tenant and actor come from server session. No official merchant/PSP environment verified; no HTTP payment dispatch endpoint. Model research jobs and payment commands have different recovery semantics.

get.summary: Safe storage and embedded research-worker readiness
get.description: Loopback-only, no database paths, SQL, task contents or credentials. Probes SQLite quick_check. A disabled embedded worker is external_unmonitored; ready in that mode does not attest to external worker liveness. Readiness is not evidence of payment settlement or historical corruption root-cause resolution. An unavailable embedded worker blocks new intents, answers, runs and approvals; stopping an existing task remains allowed if storage is available.

200.description: Local storage available and embedded worker operational, or explicitly external_unmonitored.

503.description: Storage or embedded worker unavailable. No stop, cancellation or rollback confirmation is implied.

recovery_required.description: Corruption or unexpected journal mode quarantines this process. No automatic repair or replacement is attempted.
